verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a transaction-process endpoint that runs payment screening and transaction monitoring, and lists payment screening cases as an exportable type. That establishes a first-party payment-screening capability. Case and alert review with decisions (no risk detected, risk detected – accepted or offboard) is available in the web app or via the API. However, the decision and match-inspection docs are framed around customer screening, and nothing shows the payment can be held before release or that a decision is returned synchronously for it. Missing for 10: documented pre-release hold or real-time payment decision response, documented inspection of payment-screening hits and matched entities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
